q1_issues.issue: The court is the bare direct object of "petitioned", so the Thematic-roles direct-object test (Patient only if created/destroyed/changed, otherwise Theme) yields Theme; Recipient is defined for an indirect object or a "to"-marked addressee.

q2_gaps: purposive adjunct headed by a noun ("in an effort to V", "in a bid to V"): the connective section names only "to" / "in order to" / "so as to" as purpose heads, while the noun-complement section would instead make "an effort" a witness with a To-complement, and nothing selects between them

a verb of formal address whose SOLE object is the addressee ("petitioned a court", "lobbied the agency"): the direct-object test says Theme, the Recipient clause's "addressee of communication" rationale says Recipient
notes: InAnEffortTo is defensible under the open surface-connective licence (multiword connectives CamelCase-join), but it is not one of the purpose heads the seeded PurposeOf bridge is defined over. Everything else — coalition-of-states group, the force/regulate control chain with the EPA scoped inside the embedded event only and no tense on it, and the greenhouse_gas_emission genus — matches the instruction set.
